name: TRExplorer: genome-wide tandem-repeat catalogue

version.value: Catalogue versions v1.0, v2.0 and v2.1 in the public bucket (the v2.1 hg38 base catalogue is 45.3 MB); the companion manuscript is listed as AJHG 2026

scope: A catalogue of tandem-repeat loci for genotyping with short- and long-read tools, with motif definitions, exported in the formats of ExpansionHunter, GangSTR, HipSTR, LongTR, TRGT and ATaRVa, plus variation clusters, an extended-loci table, annotation tables with polymorphism in 100 HPRC genomes, and per-source catalogue subsets. The v2.1 hg38 base catalogue (1 to 1000 bp motifs) is a 45.3 MB BED; the fully annotated tables are 0.9 to 1.2 GB.
mapping_methods: Loci are given as hg38 (and T2T-CHM13) intervals with repeat motifs, exported per genotyping tool.

quantitative.summary: Locus definitions with motif and (in the annotated tables) polymorphism and disease association annotations.

licence.name: Not found: neither the about page, the FAQ nor the bucket listing states a data licence.

update_frequency: Several catalogue versions within a year (the bucket has v1.0, v1.0.1, v1.0.2, v2.0, v2.1 and dated exports).
coverage_limitations: A catalogue of loci to genotype, not a set of allele-size distributions for a population
The annotated tables are very large
known_omissions: No files fetched: the licence is not stated; the pathogenic loci are held through STRchive

reuse_decision.rationale: Wanted for loci outside the curated pathogenic set, but the licence is not stated and the useful annotated tables are about 1 GB. Ask for the terms, then fetch the 45 MB base BED and the extended-loci table first.

status.notes: Web pages and the public bucket listing were read; no data file was downloaded.

mechanism_evidence.note: polymorphism of repeat loci in long-read genomes

evidence_profile.biological_context: Repeat loci defined from the reference sequence with motifs, annotated with polymorphism in assembled genomes of diverse ancestry (HPRC).
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: A curated and computed catalogue; polymorphism summaries come from long-read genomes of a research panel.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: None for mechanism. A locus being polymorphic or near a gene does not make an allele pathogenic; thresholds for disease come from curated sources such as STRchive.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A repeat not in the catalogue was not defined as a locus (for example a very long or impure repeat); this is not evidence that it is stable.

overlaps_with_sources.note: STRchive curates disease loci with thresholds; TRExplorer extends the locus list genome-wide
